name: @helixui/create-helix-stub
description: PLACEHOLDER STUB — the real create-helix CLI ships from github.com/bookedsolidtech/create-helix-app (npm: `create-helix@0.8.0` and up). This stub exists in the monorepo to reserve the namespace; its dist/ contents are NOT what consumers run when they invoke `npx create-helix project-name`. The local package name is intentionally scoped (`@helixui/create-helix-stub`) so workspace resolution cannot serve the stub under the production `create-helix` name. See packages/create-helix-app/README.md for the gap explanation, and apps/docs/src/content/docs/getting-started/create-helix.md for the documented PUBLISHED surface.
